title.narrative: Addressing Social Determinants of Health (SDH) for Gender Equality in Afar Regional State, Ethiopia

description.narrative: The main purpose of the contract is to support the Afar Regional Government to improve health and nutrition of its citizens with specific emphasis on women, adolescent girls and children under five years of age. Specifically, it aims to address other determinants affecting health outcomes in the region. The action is expected to achieve (i) improved access to and quality of Sexual Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR) with emphasis on increased demand for and uptake of comprehensive family planning services, (ii) increased access and quality of integrated services as well as dietary diversity for adolescent girls, PLWs and children < 5 years of age, (iii) improved health facilities readiness to provide quality services through investment on health facilities access to water supply, and (iv) build regional government capacities to effectively address harmful traditional practices with a focus of Gender Based Violence (GBV), FGM, child marriage and others.
